items.prompt: 90% of the training data for a job-screening AI comes from men. The risk?
choices: The AI is biased against women
items.explanation: AI copies the patterns in its training data. Lopsided data gives lopsided decisions.

items.prompt: An AI assistant cites "Ministerial Regulation No. 99/2025". First step?
choices: Check an official source to see if it exists
Quote it in the report right away
Trust it because AI is smart
items.explanation: AI can invent convincing-sounding sources (hallucination). Always check the original.

items.prompt: May you paste a customer list into a public AI chatbot to summarise it?
choices: No, personal data must not leave the office
Yes, if it is at night
items.explanation: Data pasted into a public AI service may be stored outside the office’s control.

items.prompt: Tap the part of the AI answer that needs checking first.

parts.text: Sales this quarter were Rp 120 million,
up 50% according to the "2031 Statistics Report".

items.explanation: A reference from the future is clearly made up. Check the number and source against the real data.
